run_contact_friction_simulation: run a pybullet simulation that loads a plane and cube and prints contact friction forces each step
load_urdf_models: load URDF models like plane and cube into a pybullet physics simulation with configurable coordinates
get_contact_points: get contact points between colliding bodies and extract normal force and lateral friction force data
set_custom_gravity: set a custom gravity vector in the pybullet simulation to control object movement
step_simulation_loop: step the pybullet simulation forward in a loop and aggregate contact point forces per frame
